description: Standing jobs: one digest owned by the calling wallet: schedule, windows closed, posted and skipped as empty, items waiting in the open window, recent windows with delivery outcomes, and one full signed digest report (the latest, or window_index). POST /api/digest-status. Standing jobs check and report: they run read-and-report Wever tools only and never move money, place orders or change state. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Every call carries X-Wever-Wallet-Proof bound to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route; a paid call adds Payment-Signature from the same wallet. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/standing-jobs-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/standing-jobs/.

window_index.description: Optional window number to return in full. Defaults to the latest posted window.
